lines.t: Verse 1
A thousand feet toward the dust,
They chase the gold that turns to grey.
While every heart forgets to trust,
I’m yearning for the Break of Day.
Chorus
Kingdoms rise and kingdoms bleed,
Like a rhythm in the tide.
But You are everything I need,
With nothing left to hide.
Let the heavens bow their head,
Let the King descend in light.
To wake the living from the dead,
In the middle of the night.
Verse 2
The current pulls a thousand ways,
A heavy tide of hollow sound.
While they are lost in neon haze,
I’m kneeling on this holy ground.
Bridge
I see the lanterns flicker low,
Along the path they choose to tread.
They’re chasing after empty shows,
And living like the silent dead.
But every breath is still a plea,
For Your face to rescue me.
Chorus
Kingdoms rise and kingdoms bleed,
Like a rhythm in the tide.
But You are everything I need,
With nothing left to hide.
Let the heavens bow their head,
Let the King descend in light.
To wake the living from the dead,
In the middle of the night.
Coda (Fade Out)
Still I’m watching...
Still I’m waiting for the light.
While the world is turning...
Turning back into the night.
Just a breath away...
Just a heartbeat from the shore.
I’m not looking back...
Not looking back anymore.
